description: Deterministic identifiers used by the Garmin upload feature. GUIDs are rendered lower-case, hyphenated (36 characters). Hashes are lower-case hex SHA-256 over the UTF-8 bytes of the key material.

idempotencyKey.notes: Unique per job, and jobs are also unique per session. The key is local only: Garmin's import endpoint has no idempotency header, so duplicate protection comes from the job state machine, not from Garmin. Migrated jobs keep their stored key verbatim.

fitSerialNumbers.sessionSerial: uint32 parsed from the first 8 hex digits of the session UUID (this equals the .NET little-endian read of Guid.ToByteArray()[0..3]).
fitSerialNumbers.mergedFileIdSerial: watchFileIdSerial XOR sessionSerial XOR 0x4D455247 ('MERG'); if the result equals watchFileIdSerial, XOR it with 1. A missing watch serial counts as 0.

watchPairingToken.token: base64url (no padding) of 32 random bytes => 43 characters
watchPairingToken.stored: lower-case hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 token string (64 characters), unique across bindings
watchPairingToken.statusEndpointAccepts: Authorization: Bearer <token>, token length 20..128 after trimming

requestFingerprint: User-initiated Garmin operations (test activity, acknowledge found, confirm absent, reprocess merge, historical recovery) carry a client-generated operationId. The server stores a receipt keyed by operationId with a 64-hex fingerprint of the request scope (profileId, jobId or sessionId, action). Same operationId + same fingerprint => replay the stored outcome; same operationId + different fingerprint => 409 'That operation ID was already used for a different request.'
